title: THE CAREER CONTROLS LIST IS A CLEAN PANEL AND THE FOLDED CHIP MATCHES THE STANDING TAG
why: The critic scored screens 80 and 79 a 2 (job 121): the opened list was a dense, tiny, dim, ragged four-column block with the f1 line twice, and the folded f1 controls chip used a different chip style from the standing tag. The list is now one opaque panel with 16px rows, a key cap plus a word on every row, four short sections (move, fight, gear, raid) in two columns and one footer line; the folded chip uses the standing tag HUD panel and label face. No key, binding or F1 behaviour changed; use item in hand now reads use item.
now: The controls list opened with F1 reads clearly: key caps, grouped, bigger. The folded f1 controls chip looks like the standing tag.
